_doc: Đạo Đồ rule constants (design/gdd/dao-do.md Formulas, Parameter keys). The map itself is dao_do_map.json (ADR-0004), exported from the v5 frozen map. road_purity: purity one element-land road node grants (a border road half to each neighbour, a hub road to each of the five; rule 4). purity_price: W per purity point (Formulas A2), used to value roads. tree_breakthrough_k: scale of the tree's breakthrough curve k*ln(1+S/k) (Formulas F). cap_realm_min: realm index a capability notable needs (rule 16; 2 = Core Formation). chaos_gate_purity: every base element must be above it to enter the Chaos land without Primordial Chaos (rule 3). w_target: the per-point target in W (Formulas A2). start_targets: the authoring guide's targets from every start (Formulas B).
name: Đạo Đồ
